title: Local comparison inequality with retracted competitors (Simon 7.2.4 (1)–(11) with Remark 7.2.5(2))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. For j ∈ ℕ let U_j ⊆ ℝ^P be open, A_j ⊆ ℝ^P, S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j) and Ŝ_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P); let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and ρ_j ∈ ℝ. Assume: (1) every S_j is minimizing in A_j (IsMinimizingIn S_j A_j) and spt S_j ⊆ A_j; (2) for every R ∈ ℝ there is c ∈ [0, ∞) with M_{B_R(0)}(S_j) ≤ c for all large j; (3) for every G > 0 there are maps π_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) and G' ∈ ℝ such that, for all large j, either A_j ∩ B_G(0) = ∅, or π_j is C¹ on B_G(0), maps B_G(0) into A_j ∩ B_{G'}(0) and is the identity on A_j ∩ B_G(0); and such that for every η > 0, for all large j, either A_j ∩ B_G(0) = ∅ or |π_j(y) − π_j(z)| ≤ (1 + η)|y − z| for all y, z ∈ B_G(0); (4) C and every Ŝ_j are integer multiplicity, sup_j (M_W(Ŝ_j) + M_W(∂Ŝ_j)) < ∞ for every bounded open W ⊆ ℝ^P, and Ŝ_j ⇀ C in ℝ^P (WeaklyConvergesOn); (5) ρ_j → ∞, closedBall(0, ρ_j) ⊆ U_j, and Ŝ_j(ω) = currentEval(S_j, ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_{ρ_j}(0). Then for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every ε > 0 and every strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ there are an open W ⊆ ℝ^P with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) = {y : dist(y, K) < ε} and a strictly increasing φ' : ℕ → ℕ such that limsup_i M_W(S_{ψ(φ'(i))}) ≤ M_W(S) for every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂S = ∂C (SameBoundary S C) and spt(S − C) ⊆ K.
